text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on the school roof trying hard to
come up with
a good training schedule
for
<chrname>, when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I came up here to read my makeup
magazine,
but I didn't realize someone
was already here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh, you don't seem so happy, though.
Wanna talk
about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. But fussin' about it all by
yourself is a
sure way to send you into a
tailspin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, a brief escape can be
exactly what
you need.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just do something completely unrelated
to get
your mind off it. Eat some
delicious food or
whatever as a mood
palate cleanser.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm doing right now! I'm
taking a
break from studying for this test
that's coming up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It helps you get back into things with a
clear
head. You know, like a mental
escape. I think
that's super important,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It helps you get back into things with a
clear
head. You know, like a mental
escape. I think
that's super important,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so cool! You're quite the hard
worker!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you don't overdo it. Take
a break
when you need it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And if you're really down and out, give
me a
shout. I always have an open ear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a result of my strong perseverance, I
manage
to draft up a satisfactory
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, do it! I'll even join you! No matter
how far
we go, I know you'll get back on
track right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How about we go to the cafeteria and
eat
something sweet? There must be
some dessert
you've been dying to try
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And as a reward for all your hard work,
I'll treat
you to it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to playing a bit of hooky—or as
Mejiro
Palmer puts it, "mentally
escaping"—I manage to
draft up a
satisfactory schedule.
